content:
sara: Hey team — quick sync. I want to run a small PLG experiment for next week's micro-launch. Goal: increase first-week DAU from new signups by +12% using a combo of free credits, targeted onboarding prompt templates, and a follow-up webinar invite. Thoughts? :thinking:

leo: Love it. Do we have a hypothesis?

sara: Hypothesis: 50 credits + 1 tailored prompt template in the welcome flow + an invite to a short 20-min 'build with Redwood' webinar will lift activation (first useful request) and retention. Primary metric = % of signups that send 3+ generation requests within 7 days. Secondary = webinar signups and attendance.

tess: How many users in the test cohort? A/B or cohort-based?

sara: Cohort A = 10k new signups over the next two weeks (randomized), Cohort B = control (no credits, generic prompts). 50/50 split.

mike: Quick checklist: landing post (launch social + changelog), onboarding email, in-product toast, and the webinar RSVP flow. I can own the email and in-product copy.

leo: For the prompt templates — can we create two variants? One focused on 'code assistant' templates, one focused on 'productivity / docs' templates. We can test which drives more token usage.

sara: Yes. Split the 10k into 2x test arms + control? Hmm maybe better: 5k credit+code-template, 5k credit+productivity-template, and control 10k. But that requires 3-way; might need more volume. Any objections?

tess: No objection. I prefer 3 arms so we can see prompt-topic lift. We'll need the telemetry tags: utm_campaign=seed-surge-50c, cohort=onboard_v2, prompt_variant=code|prod. @mike can you pass to eng to ensure events are tagged?

mike: Yep. I'll file a ticket. ETA EOD to add tags and the in-product CTA. ticket: INF-5843.

growth-bot: Snapshot: recent starter-credit experiments showed +8% activation with 30 credits and templated prompts (N=6k). Recommendation: scale credits carefully — diminishing returns after 75 credits.

sara: Good note. We'll cap at 50 for this micro. For the webinar: 20-minute live, 2 demos (prompt templates + cost controls), Q&A. CTA in email + in-product modal. Speakers: @leo (runtime demo) and @sara (prompt workshop).

leo: Draft social post copy idea: "Ship LLM features faster. Try Redwood with 50 free credits + curated prompt templates. Join our 20-min workshop next Wed. RSVP -> link" Short, punchy.

tess: Email subject A/B: A) "50 free credits to build with Redwood — 20-min workshop" B) "Build your first LLM feature today (50 free credits)" Which performs better? I'd test both for the email send.

sara: Good A/B. Mike, include both subject lines in the send config. Also set link tracking so we can attribute.

mike: Will do. Also adding a tiny onboarding nudge sequence: day 0 welcome (credits + template), day 2 usage tip (how to use KV cache / batching), day 5 webinar reminder. Short copy only.

leo: For benchmarks, what are success thresholds? Activation lift +12% (primary). Webinar RSVP >= 8% of cohort and attendance >= 40% of RSVPs. 7-day retention lift +5%. If we see token spend spike but no retention, that's a bad sign (consumption without value).

sara: Agreed. If we miss activation by >5% relative to control, we kill and iterate. If activation beats by >=12% we scale to full launch.

tess: Are we gating credits on email verification? I suggest yes — reduces abuse. Also require first request to claim credits (auto-apply to billing ledger).

mike: Implement gating: email verified -> credits applied. Also add a small fraud filter (reuse same IP + disposable email heuristics) so we don't blow credits.

growth-bot: FYI: routing tips — for inbound leads who attend the webinar and reach threshold (3+ requests), route to SDR queue 'plg-engaged' with tag=webinar_50c.

sara: Perfect. Final items: 1) Copy assets (social + email variants) — @leo/@tess 2) Onboarding templates (code + prod) — @leo 3) Eng tagging & gating — @mike 4) Webinar setup + calendar + landing page — @sara 5) Measurement dashboard (activation funnel + cohorts) — @tess. Can everyone confirm deliverables and ETA EOD tomorrow?

leo: Confirmed. I’ll drop drafts in the marketing drive by 10am PT. :white_check_mark:

tess: Confirmed. I’ll wire up the dashboard skeleton and share queries.

mike: Confirmed. Ticket INF-5843 created, gating in progress.

growth-bot: Event hooks are queued. Reminder scheduled for 48h pre-webinar.

sara: Thanks — quick post-launch retrospective scheduled for two weeks after launch. If anyone has ideas for extra variants (e.g., CTA that unlocks an extra 25 credits for attending and doing a 10-min challenge), raise them in this thread. :sparkles:
